breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction that end slopes are zero under symmetric loading. Instead, it only specifies zero deflection at x=0 and x=L as boundary conditions (the correct simply supported boundary conditions), and explicitly asks to calculate the slope at x=0, implying it is non-zero. This matches the ground truth prompt which also omits the incorrect zero-slope assumption.
